newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, Gingrich in "bipartisan" breakfast chat.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Gingrich in "bipartisan" breakfast chat.

text.p: President Clinton and House Speaker Newt Gingrich held a breakfast chat Thursday on ways to sustain bipartisanship following this week's budget agreement, White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.

"The speaker thought it would be a good idea for the two to get together after the successful but sometimes difficult negotiations over a balanced budget agreement. The president agreed that was very good idea," McCurry told reporters while the breakfast was in progress at the White House.
He said he expected Clinton, a Democrat, and Gingrich, the House's highest-ranking Republican, to talk "generally, and in a big-picture way about ways in which bipartisan cooperation can continue."
